method.memory: occupied vertex+index words plus 32-byte GPU chunk rows; excludes paint/atlas/free arena capacity; same bytes uploaded; denominator counts distinct placed line tiles; total includes all resident line meshes

variant_styles.solid: Tokyo reduced Liberty, only line layers
variant_styles.gradient: same polylines/paint plus linear line-progress red to blue ramp
variant_styles.pattern: same polylines/paint plus pinned GL JS emerald sprite generic_icon

method.browser_host: An unbundled benchmark page and Playwright driver, removed with the experiment.

layout_cpu.method: pure tile build after MVT decode, complete Tokyo style; 3 rotating rounds; 100 measured and 10 warm-up tile layouts per round

wasm.compression_method: Exact Brotli byte counts use node:zlib Brotli quality 11, lgwin 22 on cargo xtask web output; Rust compressor budget reports are rounded KiB and can differ slightly.

outcome: Shelve all four variants: fixture parity and occupied-memory gates pass; GPU gate fails decisively for every variant at z12; remove experimental code and retain this evidence.
